closes: R-1 decision (1) only — core lifetime-neutrality and re-entrancy
decisionDependencies: architecture/03 warm state is acceleration never authority

conformanceClaims.obligation: Execution core has no ambient process-global analysis state
conformanceClaims.test: Two Core instances in one process with distinct ProjectIds never share Plan/Snapshot/FactView/Program handles unless explicitly passed

conformanceClaims.obligation: All dependencies are explicit constructor/context parameters
conformanceClaims.test: Core API surface enumeration: Snapshotter, FactStore, ProviderRegistry, RuleEngine, Policy, Ledger, Clock, Budget — no hidden singletons; static analysis / depcruise forbid module-level mutable analysis state

conformanceClaims.obligation: Core is safe to instantiate twice and run concurrent Plans for different projects
conformanceClaims.test: Concurrent run(PlanA) and run(PlanB) with isolated backends; no cross-talk in EvidenceDigest inputs

conformanceClaims.obligation: One-shot host and resident host call the same Core entrypoints
conformanceClaims.test: Shared library symbol: runAnalysis(ctx, plan) -> Run; hosts differ only in process lifetime and cache retention policy object passed into ctx
Identical SnapshotId+PlanId+toolchain+exact Coverage => identical EvidenceDigest for cold ctx and warm ctx; if Coverage differs, test fails as Coverage divergence before digest compare

conformanceClaims.obligation: Dropping all warm state and re-running yields same digest when inputs equal
conformanceClaims.test: run warm; clearCaches(); run cold; digests equal

conformanceClaims.obligation: Storage writes use one transaction/CAS protocol regardless of host lifetime
conformanceClaims.test: CAS write-then-link + ledger publish sequence identical; no host-specific write path
CI profile builds without resident process; all sealed analysis features available

apiShapeSketch.note: Normative for conformance naming, not a full IDL
types: AnalysisContext { projectId, backend, providers, budgets, cachePolicy, clock }
queryFactView(ctx, factViewId, query) -> QueryResult  // never creates Run

nonRequirements: No latency SLO in this artifact
No multi-project fairness scheduling beyond isolation
